observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same Yamaha keyboard from slightly different angles, wrapped in plastic.
The keyboard has 61 keys, typical of a standard digital keyboard.
The control panel includes a central display, buttons, and a grid of colored buttons (green, orange, red, yellow).
The keyboard appears to be new or lightly used, still in protective plastic wrap.
The background shows a store environment with other electronics and boxes, including one labeled 'Yamaha'.
No power cord, stand, or accessories are visible in the photos.
The seller claims it is 'very good sound and quality' and 'all keys and buttons working'.

claims.claim: Very good sound and quality Yamaha keyboard
claims.evidence: Sound quality cannot be assessed from photos; no audio or performance test is shown. The claim of 'very good quality' is subjective and not verifiable remotely.
No photo shows the keyboard powered on or in use. The keys and buttons are not being tested. The plastic wrap may hide damage or non-functionality.
No adapter is visible in either photo. The seller's claim cannot be confirmed from the images.

claims.claim: Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
